name: Zebedee
title: The Fisherman from Galilee
summary: Zebedee was a Galilean fisherman and the father of the apostles James and John. He ran a fishing business on the Sea of Galilee together with his sons and had hired workers, which suggests that the family had some wealth. He is known for his sons leaving him in the boat to follow Jesus.

keyEvents.title: The Call of the Sons
keyEvents.description: Jesus called James and John while they were sitting in the boat with their father Zebedee, mending their nets. They immediately left the boat and their father and followed Jesus.

keyEvents.title: The Fisherman with Hired Workers
keyEvents.description: The Gospel of Mark mentions that Zebedee had hired workers in the boat, indicating that he ran an established fishing business.

keyEvents.title: The Mother's Prayer for Her Sons
keyEvents.description: Zebedee's wife (traditionally identified as Salome) came to Jesus and asked that her two sons might sit, one at his right hand and the other at his left, in his kingdom.
